description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components within an Android application's custom logging framework. It outlines a method for printing log data and supports chaining multiple logging nodes, including filters and output targets.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface that represents a logging node capable of outputting log data and passing it along a chain of log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception; typically called on the first node in the chain to handle the log message.
